title: Dinosaur's First Day of School
subtitle: You don't have to bring your house
style: flat hand-drawn illustration on speckled cream paper with tiny grey flecks, the speckled paper fills the whole square picture edge to edge with no border, simple flat colour shapes with thin wobbly outlines, muted faded colours: rusty red, soft pink, pale yellow, soft green and grey-blue, ordinary objects drawn plain, without eyes or faces, the upper third of the picture left as empty speckled paper, no words, no letters and no writing anywhere in the picture

pages.zh:
嘿，小朋友。
你知道恐龙第一天上学，
最怕什么吗？
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face wearing a small backpack, standing in front of a little school building, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Hey, kid.
Do you know what a dinosaur is most scared of
on the first day of school?

pages.zh:
不是老师。
老师是一只很温柔的
长脖子恐龙。
pages.scene: One very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face wearing round glasses and smiling gently at the door of a little school building
pages.en:
Not the teacher.
The teacher is a very gentle
long-neck.

pages.zh:
不是教室。
教室里的积木，
比小朋友还多。
pages.scene: A bright classroom with little chairs and piles of colourful wooden blocks, no dinosaurs and no people in the picture
pages.en:
Not the classroom.
The classroom has more blocks
than kids.

pages.zh:
是——
跟妈妈说再见。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face hugging the tail of one big friendly pink mother triceratops with a soft smile, small dot eyes and three blunt horns at the school gate
pages.en:
It's—
saying goodbye to Mom.

pages.zh:
小三角龙抱着妈妈的尾巴，
抱得紧紧的。
它想：「再抱一分钟。
就一分钟。」
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face clinging tightly to the tail of one big friendly pink mother triceratops with a soft smile, small dot eyes and three blunt horns with its eyes squeezed shut
pages.en:
Little Triceratops hugs Mom's tail,
tight, tight, tight.
It thinks, “One more minute of hugging.
Just one minute.”

pages.zh:
妈妈往前走一步，
它就跟着滑一步。
pages.scene: One big friendly pink mother triceratops with a soft smile, small dot eyes and three blunt horns walking forward while one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face slides along the ground still hugging her tail, little dust lines behind
pages.en:
When Mom takes one step,
it slides one step right along with her.

pages.zh:
它想了个好主意：
把家搬到学校去。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting and thinking, with a thought bubble above its head showing a small cosy house
pages.en:
It has a great idea:
bring the house to school.

pages.zh:
第二天，
它把枕头带去了。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face walking along a road to school carrying a big pillow, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
The next day,
it brings its pillow.

pages.zh:
第三天，
它把床带去了。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face dragging a whole bed along a road to school, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
On the third day,
it brings its bed.

pages.zh:
第四天，它把沙发、台灯，
还有家里的鱼缸，
全都带去了。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face pulling a cart piled high with a sofa, a lamp and a fish tank along a road, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
On the fourth day, it brings the couch, the lamp,
and the fish tank from home.
All of it.

pages.zh:
教室塞满了。
老师的头
从窗户里挤不进来了。
只挤进来一个鼻子。
pages.scene: A small classroom crammed full of home furniture: a pink sofa, a bed, a lamp and a round fish tank piled up to the ceiling, and the tiny head of one very tall long-necked grey-blue dinosaur with a tiny head, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face squeezed against the outside of the window
pages.en:
The classroom is stuffed full.
The teacher's head
can't squeeze in through the window.
Only a nose gets in.

pages.zh:
不过，有一件事，
你一定、一定要记住：
千万别让恐龙
把整个家带去上学。
pages.scene: One small backpack sitting alone on a classroom floor, nothing else in the picture
pages.en:
But there is one thing
you must never, ever forget:
never let a dinosaur
bring its whole house to school.

pages.zh:
家太大了，学校装不下。
而且，家是会等你的。
你看，家里的灯还亮着呢。
pages.scene: A small cosy house at the end of a winding road with its front door open and a warm light inside, no dinosaurs and no people in the picture
pages.en:
A house is too big to fit in a school.
And anyway, home waits for you.
Look—the light at home is still on.

pages.zh:
那天，你也在这个班上。
你的椅子，在鱼缸后面。
pages.scene: A classroom crowded with a pink sofa, a bed and a lamp, and a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts sitting on a little chair behind a round fish tank on a table, peeking around it, no dinosaurs in the picture
pages.en:
That day, you're in the same class.
Your chair is behind the fish tank.

pages.zh:
你看见小三角龙
坐在沙发和台灯中间，
一个人，眼睛红红的。
它在想妈妈。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face sitting all alone among a sofa, a lamp and a bed in a classroom, looking a little sad
pages.en:
You see Little Triceratops
sitting between the couch and the lamp,
all alone, eyes a little red.
It misses Mom.

pages.zh:
你想起来，
你第一天上学的时候，
也是这样。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts sitting on a small chair looking thoughtful, and a soft round thought cloud above him showing the same boy, smaller, hugging his smiling mother's leg at a school gate, the mother's whole body and kind face inside the cloud
pages.en:
You remember
that on your first day of school,
you felt like that too.

pages.zh:
你走过去，说：
「我可以跟你一起玩吗？」
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts walking up to one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face in the classroom
pages.en:
You walk over and say,
“Can I play with you?”

pages.zh: 「我可以帮你搭一个城堡。」
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts holding out a few wooden blocks towards one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face
pages.en: “I can help you build a castle.”

pages.zh:
小三角龙想了想：
「好吧，城堡听起来不错。」
它松开了抱着的枕头。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face letting go of a big pillow and looking at a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts
pages.en:
Little Triceratops thinks about it.
“Okay. A castle sounds good.”
It lets go of its pillow.

pages.zh:
你们用积木搭城堡。
比枕头还高。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts and one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face building a castle of wooden blocks on the classroom floor
pages.en:
You build a castle out of blocks.
Taller than the pillow.

pages.zh:
用沙发当城墙。
沙发太重了，
推得满头大汗。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts and one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face pushing a sofa into place as the wall of a block castle
pages.en:
The couch is the castle wall.
The couch is so heavy,
you push till you're all sweaty.

pages.zh:
用台灯当灯塔。
天黑都不怕了。
pages.scene: A small bedside lamp with a shade, switched on and glowing, standing on top of the tallest tower of a wooden block castle, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts and one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face looking up at it proudly
pages.en:
The lamp is the lighthouse.
Now nobody's scared of the dark.

pages.zh:
用鱼缸当护城河。
鱼很高兴。
pages.scene: A fish tank placed beside a block castle, a small fish inside looking very pleased, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts and one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face watching
pages.en:
The fish tank is the moat.
The fish is very pleased.

pages.zh:
别的小恐龙也来了。
它们排队参观。
pages.scene: One tiny yellow baby dinosaur with a round body, a short tail and stubby legs, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face and a few other small dinosaurs coming over to the block castle
pages.en:
The other little dinosaurs come too.
They line up to take a look.

pages.zh:
教室里一下子
热闹了。
连鱼缸里的鱼，
都游得更快了。
pages.scene: A classroom full of small dinosaurs playing around a big block castle, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts and one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face in the middle
pages.en:
All of a sudden,
the classroom is full of fun.
Even the fish in the tank
swims faster.

pages.zh:
放学的铃响了。
城堡还没搭完呢。
pages.scene: A small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts, one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face and small dinosaurs all looking up at a round bell on the classroom wall
pages.en:
The home-time bell rings.
The castle isn't even finished.

pages.zh:
小三角龙跑到门口——
跑得最快。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face running towards the classroom door, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
Little Triceratops runs to the door—
faster than anybody.

pages.zh:
妈妈就在门口。
一步都没有走远。
pages.scene: One big friendly pink mother triceratops with a soft smile, small dot eyes and three blunt horns waiting at the school gate with a soft smile, one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face running into her arms
pages.en:
Mom is right at the door.
She didn't go away. Not one step.

pages.zh:
第二天，
小三角龙没有带沙发。
它跑得比昨天还快。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face walking to school with only a small backpack, looking cheerful, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
The next day,
Little Triceratops doesn't bring the couch.
It runs even faster than yesterday.

pages.zh:
它只带了一块
妈妈给的小石头，
放在口袋里。
别人都不知道。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face putting one small smooth pebble into the pocket of its backpack, only one dinosaur in the picture
pages.en:
It brings just one
little stone from Mom,
tucked in its pocket.
Nobody else knows.

pages.zh:
想妈妈的时候，
就摸一摸。
pages.scene: One small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face in the classroom touching a pebble in its pocket and smiling, a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts sitting beside it
pages.en:
Whenever it misses Mom,
it gives the stone a little touch.

pages.zh:
现在你知道了：
第一天上学，不用把家带去。
带一样小东西，
交一个新朋友。
放学的时候，妈妈就在门口。
pages.scene: One big friendly pink mother triceratops with a soft smile, small dot eyes and three blunt horns waiting at a school gate in the afternoon sun, one small round friendly ochre triceratops shaped like a potato, with three short blunt horns, small dot eyes and a plain deadpan face and a small simple cartoon little boy with a short black buzz cut, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts waving goodbye to each other
pages.en:
Now you know:
you don't need to bring your house to school.
Bring one little thing,
make one new friend.
At home time, Mom will be right at the door.
